title: DNA Extraction with ZymoBIOMICS MiniPrep Kit
author: Carlos Carlos Goller

steps.title: Add sample to lysis tube
steps.instruction: Add sample (maximum input: feces 200 mg, soil 250 mg, liquid/swab 250 µL, cells 50‑100 mg wet weight (~10⁹ bacterial, 10⁸ yeast cells)) to a ZR BashingBead Lysis Tube (0.1 & 0.5 mm). Add 750 µL ZymoBIOMICS Lysis Solution and cap tightly. If using DNA/RNA Shield Lysis Tubes (Zymo Research Catalog #R1100‑50), skip the lysis solution and proceed to bead beating.

steps.title: Bead‑beat samples
steps.instruction: Secure the tubes in a bead beater with a 2 mL tube holder and process using optimized beat‑beating conditions; for a Vortex Genie with 2 mL BashingBead tubes, run for 00:40:00.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the ZR BashingBead Lysis Tubes at ≥10 000 rpm, 20 °C for 1 minute.

steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer up to 400 µL supernatant to a Zymo‑Spin III‑F Filter in a collection tube and centrifuge at 8 000 × g for 1 minute. Discard the filter.

steps.title: Add DNA binding buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1 200 µL ZymoBIOMICS DNA Binding Buffer to the filtrate in the collection tube and mix well.

steps.title: Bind DNA to column (first load)
steps.instruction: Transfer 800 µL of the mixture to a Zymo‑Spin IICR Column in a collection tube and centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 minute. Discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Bind DNA to column (second load)
steps.instruction: Transfer the remaining mixture to the same Zymo‑Spin IICR Column and centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 minute. Discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer 1
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL ZymoBIOMICS DNA Wash Buffer 1 to the IICR Column in a new collection tube, centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 minute, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer 2 (first)
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL ZymoBIOMICS DNA Wash Buffer 2 to the IICR Column, centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 minute, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer 2 (second)
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL ZymoBIOMICS DNA Wash Buffer 2 to the IICR Column and centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 minute.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the IICR Column to a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, add 100 µL (minimum 50 µL) ZymoBIOMICS DNase/RNase‑Free Water directly onto the column matrix, incubate for 00:01:00, then centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 minute to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Prepare HRC filter
steps.instruction: Place a Zymo‑Spin III‑HRC Filter in a new collection tube, add 600 µL ZymoBIOMICS HRC Prep Solution, and centrifuge at 8 000 × g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Filter eluted DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the eluate from Step 11 to the prepared III‑HRC Filter in a clean 1.5 mL tube and centrifuge at exactly 16 000 × g for 3 minutes. The filtered DNA is now suitable for PCR and downstream applications.
